images.alt: Left image of infection on leaves. Center yellow arrows indicate reproductive organs. Right center top and bottom shows cleistothecia reproductive organs. Right shows russeting on Elestar and Fugi cultivars.

The fungus overwinters in buds and potentially chasmothecia. In early spring primary infections occur on green tips. In late spring and summer more leaves and shoots become infected. In fall cleistothecia occur and infections of terminal shoots and blossom buds.

Stayman, granny smith, rome beauty, and idared are highly susceptible. Breaburn, Cameo, Cripps Pink, Empire, Golden delicious, Honeycrisp, Jonagold, and Liberty are susceptible. Cosmic crisp, Pinova, Red delicious, Gala, Crimson crisp are moderately resistant. Ambrosia, Fugi and Cameo are resistant.
Suppported by the WSU Tree Fruit Endowment
